business_summary: CITIC Pacific Special Steel Group Co., Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of steel materials in China. It offers bearing, gear, non-quenched and tempered free cutting, spring, mooring chain, and energy steel, as well as continuous casting round billet; pipeline steel, ship and ocean engineering steel, rack steel, container steel, boiler steel, nickel series ultra-low temperature steel, high-strength steel, wear-resistant steel, steel for wind power, die steel, bridge steel, and steel for high buildings; and special steel wire, including fastener, spring, cord, wire-rope, and carbon structural steel, as well as special steel wire for welding electrode. The company also provides oil casing, oil tubing, line pipe, ocean engineering structural pipe, ocean bracing pipe, structural alloy pipe, boiler tube, nuclear power pipe, fertilizer pipe, mechanical tube, cracking tube, fluid transmission pipeline, cylinder tube, and cylinder line; tool and die steel, ultra-high strength steel, corrosion resistant alloy, and stainless steel; and leaf spring, and guide arm. Its products are used for automobile manufacturing, rail transit, engineering machinery, electrical energy, petrochemical engineering, machine, shipbuilding, bridge construction, nuclear power, petroleum, gas, marine engineering, chemical engineering, railway transportation, wind power, water power, die, high buildings, ship and ocean engineering, and turbine applications. The company was formerly known as Daye Special Steel Co., Ltd. and changed its name to CITIC Pacific Special Steel Group Co., Ltd. in September 2019. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Jiangyin, China. Citic Pacific Special Steel Group Co., Ltd is a subsidiary of CITIC Pacific Special Steel Investment Limited.
business_summary_ko: CITIC Pacific Special Steel Group Co., Ltd는 중국에서 철강재를 제조 및 판매하는 회사입니다. 베어링, 기어, 비급냉 및 템퍼링 쾌삭, 스프링, 계류 체인, 에너지강 및 연속 주조 원형 빌렛을 제공합니다. 파이프라인강, 선박해양공학강, 랙강, 컨테이너강, 보일러강, 니켈계 초저온강, 고장력강, 내마모강, 풍력용강, 금형강, 교량강, 고층건물용강; 화스너, 스프링, 코드, 와이어로프, 탄소구조강 등의 특수강선과 용접전극용 특수강선 등이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 오일 케이싱, 오일 튜빙, 라인 파이프, 해양 엔지니어링 구조 파이프, 해양 브레이싱 파이프, 구조 합금 파이프, 보일러 튜브, 원자력 파이프, 비료 파이프, 기계 튜브, 크래킹 튜브, 유체 전송 파이프라인, 실린더 튜브 및 실린더 라인을 제공합니다. 공구 및 다이강, 초고장력강, 내식성 합금 및 스테인레스강; 판 스프링 및 가이드 암. 해당 제품은 자동차 제조, 철도 운송, 엔지니어링 기계, 전기 에너지, 석유화학 산업에 사용됩니다.
